abilities.effect: The ward’s equations spiral and swirl, drawing the mind into an inescapable conundrum. The triggering creature is dealt 4d10+26 mental damage (DC 32 basic Will save). On a failure, the target is additionally stupefied 2, or stupefied 4 on a critical failure.
abilities.name: Mental Conundrum

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text:
This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to occult magic.

abilities.trigger: A creature touches the door directly or with a tool

hazard.description: A complex geometrical ward with mathematical equations woven into its lines magically seals the door, harming anyone who touches it.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 30 (master) to sabotage the ward, Geometry or Mathematics Lore DC 25 (trained) to calculate the solution to the complex equations, Crafting DC 28 (expert) to manipulate the ward’s precise underlying schematics, or *dispel magic* (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magical ward
hazard.name: Conundrum Ward
hazard.reset: The trap automatically resets after being triggered. If disabled, the ward does not reset.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
